_comment: Which frame of which composition becomes which phase diagram.
Frame numbers come from each composition's own timing constants, never from
eyeballing a scrubber. Each still sits comfortably INSIDE an act so the cues
have settled — not on the boundary, where a transition is mid-flight.
WATCH THE TIMEBASE. SalidaShort's anchors (T_PRESS, T_DROP, ...) live on an
unscaled internal timeline and the composition plays back at SLOW = 1.46, so
a still frame is internal x 1.46. PressTrapShort's scene constants are
relative to START_AT = 130. The others are plain composition frames.
Keep in sync with src/data/systems.ts — the `frame` values must match.
_cropBottom: Pixels removed from the bottom of every exported still. The compositions burn a caption bar plus the channel logo down there; on the web the caption duplicates the prose beside the image, and some kicker chips print the composition id. Override per system where a board sits lower in frame.
